display.title: Episode 416 (Alternate Opening): Matan Torah Again
display.summary_short: A five-minute alternate take of the opening of episode 416: the greeting and the start of the Matan Torah talk for Parshas Yisro, cut off mid-sentence.
display.summary_long: A short alternate recording of the start of episode 416 of the Tzivos Hashem radio show, marked 'new'. After a brief lead-in, Uncle Yossi greets the listeners and begins the Parshas Yisro talk: the Torah was given in the year 2448, so in 5750 it was 3,302 years ago. He explains the Alter Rebbe's teaching to 'live with the times', which the Mitteler Rebbe explained as living with the weekly parsha, and announces that the Ten Commandments will be read in shul this Shabbos. The recording stops after about five minutes, in the middle of a sentence urging everyone to come to shul. The complete episode, with the rest of the talk, the story and Mitzvah Time, is a separate file.
